name: declarationbase
title: DeclarationBase
description: Keys common to all declarations used with the Remote Management protocol.

payloadkeys.title: Type
payloadkeys.content: A string specifying the type of this declaration.

payloadkeys.title: Identifier
payloadkeys.content: A string uniquely identifying this declaration. The size of this string shouldn't exceed 64 octets. A UUID string value is a good choice.

payloadkeys.title: Server token
payloadkeys.content: A unique token generated by the server specifying a particular revision of the declaration. The size of this string shouldn't exceed 64 octets.
